title: 1RB1LC_1LC1RD_1LA0LB_0RB1RE_1RF0RA_---0RC halts, after about 3.47·10<sup>41</sup> steps
text: The orbit of the A(a, b) rules from A(2, 9) reaches A(139754396279488, 139754396279492) at visit 79,859,656,218,973 (a even, b − a = 4), so the next visit is A(279508792558980, 3) and the machine halts after 346,613,804,468,191,894,895,080,818,748,230,768,977,389 steps. The rules and halts_iff_rules are proved in Lean; the orbit was followed in C three ways (blocks proved sound in Lean, one visit at a time in 80 segments with exact step counts, and the old runner over the last stretch).
